# Retained source catalog

The catalog preserves the reviewed separator round-2 source inputs at
02fd46deed3a7f482e6758a776dff2e657c3e6d1: 129 allow, 52 deny and seven ask entries.
Public overlays replace some original documents. Tests merge these historical
entries with every current source entry, labeling historical origins explicitly.
Private-tree assertions still require their actual current source. Public-tree
checks require the published changelog and retain the removed historical scalar
example. The digest test prevents refreshing this fixture to hide a regression.
One source label says "an unpublished working note" in place of the name of a
document that is not published; its entry and every other label are unchanged.
